vars.name: AGB_AGY_BIN
vars.description: Path or name of the agy executable used for builds, quota telemetry, doctor checks and bootstrap.

vars.name: AGB_ALLOW_DIRTY
vars.description: Set to 1 to let agb run start against a repository with uncommitted changes (otherwise the run refuses to start).

vars.name: AGB_BUILD_TIMEOUT
vars.description: Per-ticket builder timeout passed to agy. For stream-json output, 0 (or empty) means no wall-clock limit; the ceiling and no-progress watchdog still apply.

vars.name: AGB_BUILD_MAX_TIMEOUT
vars.description: Hard ceiling on a single agy invocation, applied even when AGB_BUILD_TIMEOUT is 0.

vars.name: AGB_EVENT_PROGRESS_TIMEOUT
vars.description: No-progress watchdog: an agy stream that emits no events for this long is terminated.

vars.name: AGB_GATE_TIMEOUT_MS
vars.description: Per-gate execution timeout in milliseconds for deterministic build/test gates in lib/scheduler.mjs.

vars.name: AGB_KILL_GRACE_MS
vars.description: Milliseconds to wait between SIGTERM and SIGKILL when stopping an agy process tree.

vars.name: AGB_PROVIDER
vars.description: Only the value jetski is meaningful: bootstrap then installs plugins through the jetski runner.

vars.name: AGB_SESSION_ID
vars.description: Fallback session id used to locate the active brain when ANTIGRAVITY_CONVERSATION_ID is unset; forwarded to builder agy processes.

vars.name: ANTIGRAVITY_CONVERSATION_ID
vars.description: Current Antigravity conversation id. Used to locate the active brain and artifact directory, and forwarded to builder agy processes.

vars.name: ANTIGRAVITY_WORKSPACE
vars.description: Set by agb on builder agy processes (alongside AGY_WORKSPACE and PWD) to the isolated ticket worktree path so headless companion hooks always resolve the worktree root.

vars.name: AGB_TARGET_REPO
vars.description: Target repository path checked by bin/node-launcher.sh; any candidate Node binary whose realpath resolves inside AGB_TARGET_REPO (or the current working directory) is rejected to prevent repo-planted binary execution.

vars.name: AGB_DEFAULT_EFFORT
vars.description: Optional Strike-0 effort level override (low, medium, high, xhigh, max) passed as --effort to agy when ticket.effort is unset.

vars.name: AGB_WARM_STRIKES
vars.description: Set to 0 to disable warm second-strike builder resumption via agy --conversation <id> when a ticket fails its first attempt on the same model.

vars.name: AGB_ROUTER_STATIC
vars.description: Set to 1 to bypass empirical BanditModelRouter candidate re-ranking and preserve static TIER_CANDIDATES order.

vars.name: AGB_MODEL_STATS_FILE
vars.description: Unbundled override path for the BanditModelRouter empirical model outcome ledger recorded by agb run and read by agb plan; ignored in bundled plugin builds.

vars.name: AGB_FACTORY_LEDGER_FILE
vars.description: Unbundled override path for the append-only Factory Economics Ledger written by agb run and read by Mission Control; ignored in bundled plugin builds.

vars.name: AGB_WORKER_BUILD_CMD
vars.description: Set by agb on ticketed builder agy processes when plan.gate.build is a valid npm run script; permits the PreToolUse shell guard to allow that exact build gate command.

vars.name: AGB_WORKER_MODE
vars.description: Set by agb on read-only worker agy processes (value readonly). The PreToolUse guard denies mutations and never prompts while it is set.

vars.name: AGB_WORKER_TICKET
vars.description: Set by agb on builder agy processes to the ticket id; the PreToolUse guard scopes writes to that ticket and never prompts.

vars.name: AGB_RESCUE_TICKET
vars.description: Set by agb rescue on interactive agy -i sessions to protect .booster IPC tokens and rescue locks via PreToolUse while preserving interactive operator prompts.

vars.name: AGY_BIN
vars.description: Override path for the agy CLI executable used by scripts/stage-marketplace-plugin.mjs when validating staged plugin bundles.

vars.name: PLUGIN_ROOT
vars.description: Plugin root directory exported by Antigravity (via ${PLUGIN_ROOT} in hooks.json and mcp_config.json) and resolved by bin/hook-runner.sh and bin/node-launcher.sh.

vars.name: ADLC_ANTIGRAVITY_PLUGIN_NAME
vars.description: Not read from the environment: a source constant in lib/plugin-paths.mjs naming the companion plugin's directory under the agy plugins folder.

vars.name: ADLC_GEMINI_PLUGIN_NAME
vars.description: Not read from the environment: a source constant in lib/plugin-paths.mjs naming the adlc-gemini companion plugin directory snapshotted for run integrity and checked when adlc-antigravity is absent.

vars.name: ADLC_ANTIGRAVITY_PLUGIN_PATH
vars.description: Source checkout of the adlc-antigravity plugin to install from. Honoured by bootstrap only in unbundled runs and only together with AGB_DEV_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_PLUGIN=1.

vars.name: AGB_DEV_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_PLUGIN
vars.description: Set to 1 (unbundled runs only) to let bootstrap install an unverified companion plugin from ADLC_ANTIGRAVITY_PLUGIN_PATH.

vars.name: AGB_PLUGIN_DIR
vars.description: Override directory for the companion-plugin handshake manifest in lib/adlc-bridge.mjs (honoured in unbundled source runs only).

vars.name: AGB_PLUGIN_ROOT
vars.description: Plugin root holding vendor/adlc, used to find the vendored adlc CLI. Unbundled runs only.

vars.name: ADLC_CLI_PATH
vars.description: Custom adlc executable. Honoured only with AGB_ALLOW_CUSTOM_ADLC_CLI=1 in unbundled runs; the bundled build uses only the vendored adlc.

vars.name: AGB_ADLC_BIN
vars.description: Alias of ADLC_CLI_PATH with the same restrictions (AGB_ALLOW_CUSTOM_ADLC_CLI=1, unbundled only).

vars.name: AGB_ALLOW_CUSTOM_ADLC_CLI
vars.description: Set to 1 to honour ADLC_CLI_PATH / AGB_ADLC_BIN in unbundled runs. The path must pass the temporary/world-writable path checks.

vars.name: AGB_ALLOW_SYSTEM_ADLC
vars.description: Set to 1 to let unbundled runs fall back to an adlc found on the system PATH.

vars.name: ADLC_ADMIN_KEY
vars.description: HMAC key used to verify a Windows sandbox-bypass attestation. Treated as a secret: never forwarded to builder agy processes.

vars.name: ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY
vars.description: Key used by adlc gate-manifest. Treated as a secret: never forwarded to builder agy processes.

vars.name: ADLC_P4_ENFORCEMENT
vars.description: Set to 1 by the scheduler on builder processes when rail enforcement is available, enabling the PreToolUse rails hook.

vars.name: ADLC_PROVIDER
vars.description: Read by the @adlc tools, not by agb. Bootstrap suggests ADLC_PROVIDER=agy to run them on Antigravity quota.

vars.name: ADLC_TICKET
vars.description: Set by the scheduler on builder processes to the ticket id whose rails the PreToolUse hook enforces.

vars.name: ADLC_TICKETS
vars.description: Alternative ticket-store path the PreToolUse guard also protects.

vars.name: ADLC_TICKET_STORE
vars.description: Ticket-store path override the PreToolUse guard also protects.

vars.name: AGB_ALLOW_CODEGRAPH_MCP
vars.description: Set to 1 to allow CodeGraph MCP queries (codegraph_explore) in headless or read-only agb worker sessions (still restricted to paths inside the declared workspace and outside boosterDataRoots).

vars.name: AGB_HOOK_DISABLE
vars.description: Any non-empty value bypasses the PreToolUse rails guard. Each bypass is logged to hooks.log and agb doctor warns about it.

vars.name: AGB_REQUIRE_DRIVER_SIGNATURE
vars.description: Set to 1 to make the Windows doctor sandbox check require a signed driver attestation in the probe output.

vars.name: AGB_SANDBOX_GATES
vars.description: Set to 0 to run gate commands without the OS sandbox (an explicit acknowledgement of host risk).

vars.name: AGB_SANDBOX_PROBE_CMD
vars.description: Doctor sandbox-probe command override. Restricted to test execution; otherwise the check fails.

vars.name: AGB_SANDBOX_PROBE_HELPER
vars.description: Helper script passed to the doctor sandbox probe. Honoured only during test execution.

vars.name: AGB_STRICT_GATES
vars.default: on in plan; off in run unless the repo has package.json
vars.description: Plan compilation uses strict gates unless set to 0. At run time, 1 forces gate commands to match the npm pattern even without a package.json.

vars.name: AGB_DISABLE_ORCHESTRATOR
vars.description: Set to 1 to disable routing frontier tickets to gemini-pro-orchestrator and gemini-pro-orchestrator-argon, falling back to FRONTIER_NO_ORCHESTRATOR.

vars.name: AGB_POOLS_DIR
vars.description: Directory for the shared pool state, v2 state and lock files.

vars.name: AGB_POOLS_LOCK
vars.description: Explicit pool lock file path (otherwise derived from AGB_POOLS_DIR or AGB_QUOTA_STATE).

vars.name: AGB_POOLS_V2
vars.description: Explicit v2 pool state file path (otherwise derived from AGB_POOLS_DIR or AGB_QUOTA_STATE).

vars.name: AGB_QUOTA_STATE
vars.description: Explicit shared quota state file path; the v2 and lock paths are derived from it when not set.

vars.name: AGB_QUOTA_TIMEOUT_MS
vars.description: Maximum milliseconds a ticket waits for a quota reset before failing.

vars.name: AGB_SIDECAR_PORT
vars.description: Default port for agb sidecar; --port overrides it.

vars.name: ANTIGRAVITY_SIDECAR_WEB_PORT
vars.description: Selects unauthenticated Jetski mode (token = null) and sets the listen port in sidecars/jetski-launcher.mjs only. sidecars/server.mjs and agb sidecar always enforce explicit tokens regardless of this variable.
vars.security: In sidecars/jetski-launcher.mjs, disables token auth (passes token = null to serveSidecar) for Jetski mode; sidecars/server.mjs and agb sidecar always enforce explicit tokens.

vars.name: AGB_ARTIFACT_DIR
vars.description: Where agb writes plan artifacts.

vars.name: AGB_BRAIN_DIR
vars.description: Antigravity brain directory searched for plans.

vars.name: AGB_CALIBRATION_DIR
vars.description: Where agb probe appends its probes-<day>.md calibration file.

vars.name: AGB_EXEC_CACHE_DIR
vars.description: Cache directory for authenticated executables.

vars.name: AGB_EXEC_LOCKS_DIR
vars.description: Directory for executable lock records; stale locks with a dead PID are recovered.

vars.name: AGB_HOME_DIR
vars.description: Home directory override for agb's per-user state. Ignored in bundled plugin builds (IS_BUNDLED === true).

vars.name: AGB_MOCK_CONTAINMENT_MECHANISM
vars.description: Test double for kernel containment detection.

vars.name: AGB_MOCK_CONTAINMENT_UNAVAILABLE
vars.description: Test double: report kernel containment unavailable.

vars.name: AGB_MOCK_WIN_CANARY
vars.description: Test double for the Windows sandbox canary path.

vars.name: AGB_TEST_PASSWD_HOME
vars.description: Test-only override for PASSWD_HOME in bin/hook-runner.sh when running from an unbundled source checkout containing test/hook-runner.test.mjs; unconditionally ignored when staged under .gemini/config/plugins/.

vars.name: AGB_ARBITER_MODEL
vars.description: Override the model slug used by the neutral arbiter during 5-lens Adversarial Review Loop triage.

vars.name: AGB_BRAIN_MODEL
vars.description: Override the frontier model slug used for Stage A brain-to-plan conversion.

vars.name: AGB_BRAIN_REPAIR_MODEL
vars.description: Override the fallback model slug used when repairing invalid Stage A plan JSON.

vars.name: AGB_COLDSTART_MODEL
vars.description: Override the model slug used by the coldstart self-sufficiency gate.

vars.name: AGB_GRAPH_COUPLING_FILE
vars.description: Path to an optional static import-graph coupling JSON file consulted by applyMergeForecast and scanStaticImportCoupling.

vars.name: AGB_HUD
vars.description: Set to 0 to disable the inline ANSI status bar during agb run, or 1 to force-enable it.

vars.name: AGB_PARALLAX_JUDGE_MODEL
vars.description: Override the model slug used by the parallax contract judge.

vars.name: AGB_PARALLAX_READER_MODEL
vars.description: Override the model slug used by the parallax edge reader.

vars.name: AGB_PREMORTEM_MODEL
vars.description: Override the model slug used by the advisory premortem gate.

vars.name: AGB_SYNC_MODELS_OFFLINE
vars.description: Set to 1 to use the built-in static model catalog instead of invoking agy models during doctor or sync-models.

vars.name: AGB_SKIP_SESSION_BOOTSTRAP
vars.description: Set to 1 in unbundled test runs to skip automatic background bootstrap in hooks/session-start.mjs; ignored in bundled plugin builds.

vars.name: AGB_STATUSLINE_QUOTA_FILE
vars.description: Unbundled override path for the lock-free statusline quota cache written by lib/cli-statusline.mjs and read by PoolSet.refreshQuota; ignored in bundled plugin builds.

vars.name: AGB_IGNORE_STATUS_QUOTA_CACHE
vars.description: Set to 1 to force PoolSet.refreshQuota to bypass agb_statusline_quota.json and spawn agy -p /quota directly.

vars.name: AGB_HOLDOUT_DIR
vars.description: Unbundled override directory for sealed Dark-Factory holdout scenarios staged and executed during P5 verification; ignored in bundled plugin builds.

vars.name: AGB_CANDIDATE_ROOT
vars.default: set by agb on holdout runners
vars.description: Exported by lib/holdout.mjs to the isolated candidate worktree path during P5 holdout verification so out-of-tree holdout scenarios can dynamically import candidate modules.

vars.name: AGB_LIFECYCLE_HOOKS
vars.description: Set to 0 to bypass the advisory in-session lifecycle hooks (PostToolUse, PreInvocation, PostInvocation, Stop) in hooks/lifecycle.mjs.

vars.name: AGB_CODEGRAPH
vars.description: Set to 0 to disable opt-in CodeGraph (.codegraph/) context slicing, blast-radius scoring, and impacted-test resolution, falling back to zero-dependency static-AST mode.

vars.name: AGB_DECISION_ENGINE
vars.description: Set to 0 to disable the System-1 Decision Engine (lens gating, typed Arbiter triage, coldstart screening, and low-risk fast-ship), including GEMINI_API_KEY auto-detection and .adlc/config.json settings.

vars.name: AGB_DECISION_PROVIDER
vars.description: Explicitly selects the System-1 Decision Engine provider (gemini-decisions, jev, or kev) used by lib/decision-engine.mjs, overriding GEMINI_API_KEY auto-detection.

vars.name: TYPESAFE_API_KEY
vars.description: API key for the TypeSafe Jev System-1 Decision Engine provider (jev-latest). Treated as a secret and scrubbed from error output.

vars.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
vars.description: API key for the Google Gemini Decisions API System-1 provider (gemini-decision-1 at v1beta/decisions, zero output tokens). Auto-detected and prioritized by default unless AGB_DECISION_ENGINE=0 or another provider is explicitly configured. Treated as a secret and scrubbed from error output.

vars.name: AGB_KEV_BASE_URL
vars.description: Base HTTPS (or loopback HTTP) endpoint URL for a local or self-hosted Kev / OpenRouter-compatible System-1 Decision Engine provider.

vars.name: AGB_KEV_API_KEY
vars.description: Optional Bearer API key for the kev System-1 Decision Engine provider (falls back to OPENROUTER_API_KEY if unset). Scrubbed from error output.

vars.name: AGB_ALLOW_REPO_KEV_URL
vars.description: Set to 1 to permit a non-loopback accelerators.decision.baseUrl from repository .adlc/config.json for the kev provider (host API keys are still never attached to repo-configured URLs).

ignore.name: AGB_USER_HOME
ignore.reason: Internal variable exported by bin/node-launcher.sh to pass the host user home directory into the PreToolUse policy guard when HOME is isolated to .agb_home.
